Summer Day Camps!
FBCM is hosting FREE Summer Day Camps on the second Saturday of each month, 10AM-12:30PM, for children ages 4 through just finished 5th grade! These are a great opportunity to invite a friend, meet the neighborhood, and beat the Summer heat. All children must be accompanied by a parent/guardian, and adults are encouraged to participate in the family fun alongside their kids. Contact children@fbcmuncie.org for questions or to volunteer! Book Recommendation: "All the Things I Say to God"
"All the Things I Say to God" is a book that follows Abby, a little girl, who is learning to pray with her mom. Each page, Abby learns a different way to pray. As you read this story, try each of the ways Abby learns to pray with your family. Maybe you can focus on each prayer practice for a week throughout the Summer.
